name: Standing Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Stand or sit tall and extend your target arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Turn your palm to face forward with your fingers pointing upward toward the ceiling.
Use your opposite hand to gently grasp your fingers.
Pull your fingers and palm backward toward your body until you feel a comfortable stretch along the underside of your forearm and wrist.
Hold the stretch steady for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing normally.
Gently release and repeat on the other side.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbow straight to stretch both the wrist and elbow attachments of the flexor muscles.
Apply gentle, even pressure across all four fingers without bending them excessively backward at the knuckle.
Do not force through tingling or numbness in the fingers.

sources.attribution: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program
